findings.summary: The search/tab section reimplements a bespoke filter bar (raw label + input + custom search icon) instead of reusing the shared FilterBar primitive, so it lacks the standard heading, result count, and clear affordances used across the app.
findings.fix: Where the tab layout allows, move the search into FilterBar (searchValue/onSearchChange/searchPlaceholder) or at minimum align styling with FilterBar; if tabs must stay inline, keep them as a separate tablist but route the search box through FilterBar so it shares the app's search/clear/result pattern.

findings.summary: The search input has no clear (X) button and no result-count text, unlike FilterBar which provides isDirty/onClear and resultText, so users cannot quickly reset the search or see how many items matched.
findings.fix: Add a clear button that resets search when non-empty (aria-label 'مسح البحث') and render a result count line (e.g. 'عدد النتائج: {tasks.length}' for the active tab) with aria-live='polite', mirroring FilterBar's filter-result/filter-clear behavior.

findings.summary: The create-task error banner uses hardcoded Tailwind colors (bg-red-500/10, text-red-700) instead of the design-system danger tokens, so it won't adapt to dark theme or match other error surfaces.
findings.fix: Replace with token-based styling, e.g. className="rounded-xl bg-[var(--danger-soft)] p-3 text-sm font-bold text-[var(--danger)]" to match the app's danger palette and dark-theme support.

findings.summary: TaskAction's 'مكتملة' state uses hardcoded text-emerald-700 rather than the --success token, breaking token consistency and dark-theme adaptation.
findings.fix: Use text-[var(--success)] instead of text-emerald-700 for the completed indicator.

findings.summary: The loading state is a single bespoke pulsing card block that does not resemble the actual content (metrics row + tabs + table), giving a jarring skeleton-to-content transition inconsistent with the app's loading pattern.
findings.fix: Use the shared LoadingScreen primitive, or build a skeleton that mirrors the metric grid and table rows so the placeholder matches the loaded layout.

findings.summary: The decorative Search icon inside the search label is not marked aria-hidden, unlike FilterBar which sets aria-hidden='true' on its Search icon.
findings.fix: Add aria-hidden="true" to the <Search /> icon on line 64 so it is not exposed to assistive tech.

findings.summary: The create-task error banner is not announced to screen readers because it lacks a live region role, so users relying on AT won't hear the failure message.
findings.fix:
Add role="alert" (or aria-live="assertive") to the error

so the failure message is announced when it appears.

findings.summary: The metrics section is a raw <section> with grid classes rather than using the app's dashboard/metric container convention, and mixes MetricCard (good) with an ad-hoc wrapper; minor but the breakpoint set (sm/xl) differs from other pages' metric grids.
findings.fix: Confirm the metric grid breakpoints match sibling management pages (e.g. sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4) so the four MetricCards wrap consistently with the rest of the app.
